no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not taken to an Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee meeting because there were no issues with the trial design, conduct, endpoint or data analysis.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the original NDA205552 approval of IMBRUVICA (ibrutinib) for mantle cell lymphoma. The Orig1s000 Summary Review (2013) states the application was not taken to an Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee meeting because there were no issues with trial design, conduct, endpoint or data analysis, the risk-benefit was positive, and no safety issues required an expert committee. With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
